description: Fields from competitors/findings.jsonl that the contract has no place for, keyed by contract record_id / claim_id. Not read by the team validator or exporter.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0001.value: BMW Curved Display: 12.3" digital instrument display + 14.9" control display, BMW Operating System 8.5; no front-passenger display listed
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0001.notes: Part of standard BMW Live Cockpit Plus (also BMW Maps, BMW Controller, 4G LTE). Live Cockpit Professional only via Innovationspaket 7EW. No passenger screen appears anywhere in the DE July 2026 price list.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0002.value: BMW Head-Up Display only as part of Innovationspaket 7EW, EUR 2,400
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0002.notes: Not available stand-alone: 7EW bundles BMW Live Cockpit Professional incl. HUD, interior camera and Parking Assistant Plus (Surround View, Remote 3D View, Drive Recorder). Not standard on any model, incl. i5 M60.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0003.value: Not stated in DE price list
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0003.notes: Price list only lists Klimaautomatik (standard) and 4-zone Klimaautomatik (Comfort Paket 7VB; standard on i5 M60). It does not describe whether climate is operated by physical controls or the touchscreen. Cross-reference: BMW's US launch press release for the same G60 interior says air conditioning and ventilation are controlled via the touch function on the control display (record bmw_baseline_outlook-E0024).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0004.value: BMW Intelligent Personal Assistant (term 2 years) + '3rd party Assistants' (Connected Package Professional)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0004.notes: Price list does not say whether the assistant is LLM-based or natural-language. Assistant is time-limited to 2 years as listed (renewal via ConnectedDrive).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0005.value: Smartphone Integration incl. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, 'permanently available in the vehicle'; wireless operation not stated in the price list
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0005.notes: Part of standard Connected Package Professional. Wireless charging tray, WiFi interface and Personal eSIM also standard.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0006.value: Remote Software Upgrade standard; OTA navigation map updates and Vehicle Apps included for 2 years
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0006.notes: Part of BMW Live Cockpit Plus; ConnectedDrive Services term 2 years. Price list does not define the scope of Remote Software Upgrade (e.g. which ECUs/functions).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0007.value: BMW Digital Key standard; keyless Komfortzugang only in Travel Paket 7LK (EUR 1,900)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0007.notes: Price list does not state the technology (NFC vs UWB / Digital Key Plus). Travel Paket also adds automatic tailgate and Travel & Comfort System.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0008.value: Autobahnassistent 5AX (EUR 850): hands-off extended steering assist up to 130 km/h on motorways in Germany + lane change with gaze confirmation
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0008.notes: Requires Driving Assistant Professional 5AU (EUR 2,100), which itself requires Innovationspaket 7EW (EUR 2,400): EUR 5,350 for hands-off on a 520i. Hands-off needs ConnectedDrive services (2-year term); gaze-confirmed lane change works without. Standard Driving Assistant is warnings only; 5AT Driving Assistant Plus (EUR 1,000) adds ACC 30-180 km/h and lane centring up to 180 km/h; 5AU raises both to 210 km/h.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0009.value: Automated parking (Parking Assistant: Parkassistent, reversing assistant up to 50 m) standard; remote/smartphone manoeuvring via Parking Assistant Professional 5DW optional (EUR 1,150; EUR 350 with Innovationspaket): up to 10 trained manoeuvres of up to 200 m each, reversing assistant 200 m
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0009.notes: Convention: availability = basic automated parking; remote/advanced tier in value. 5DW requires Travel Paket 7LK. Surround View and Remote 3D View only via Innovationspaket 7EW (Parking Assistant Plus).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0010.value: Active front seat ventilation only within Comfort Paket 7VB, EUR 2,750 (EUR 1,150 on i5 M60)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0010.notes: Not standard on any DE model. Comfort Paket also adds electric memory driver seat, front + rear seat heating and 4-zone climate. Standard: sports seats with lumbar support and front seat heating.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0011.value: No massage function in the DE July 2026 price list
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0011.notes: Seat options listed are Komfortsitze vorn 456 (EUR 930, requires Comfort Paket) and M Multifunktionssitze 4MA (EUR 1,750); neither description mentions massage. Absence from the price list, not an explicit 'not available' statement.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0012.value: Rear seat heating + 4-zone climate via Comfort Paket 7VB (EUR 2,750); rear sun blinds 416 (electric rear window, manual side, EUR 600); no rear screens, rear seat ventilation or rear recline listed
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0012.notes: Standard: 40:20:40 split-folding rear backrest only. 4-zone climate standard on i5 M60. Travel & Comfort System (seat-back mounting system) in Travel Paket 7LK.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0013.value: No air suspension item in the DE price list; adaptive dampers via Adaptives Fahrwerk Professional 2VV (EUR 2,440 on 520i; standard on i5 xDrive40, i5 M60, 550e)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0013.notes: 2VV = electronically controlled dampers + Integral Active Steering, not air springs. M Sportfahrwerk 704 in M Sportpaket. The standard-equipment list is only 'selected' (extraction note 17), so unlisted standard hardware cannot be excluded. Cross-reference: BMW's US launch press release states the i5 has rear-axle air suspension as standard (record bmw_baseline_outlook-E0034); the DE list is silent on this for i5.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0014.trim_scope: 520i / i5 eDrive40 (optional); i5 xDrive40, i5 M60, 550e (standard)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0014.value: Integral-Aktivlenkung (integral active steering incl. rear-axle steering) within Adaptives Fahrwerk Professional 2VV, EUR 2,440 (EUR 1,990 with M Sportpaket)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0014.notes: Standard on i5 xDrive40, i5 M60 xDrive and 550e xDrive. Adaptives M Fahrwerk Professional 2VW (EUR 4,100; xDrive40/M60/550e only) adds active roll stabilisation. Price list itself does not spell out 'rear-axle steering'; Integral-Aktivlenkung is BMW's name for combined front/rear steering.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0015.notes: i5 xDrive40 487-581 km, i5 M60 xDrive 473-539 km WLTP. PHEV electric range 84-105 km WLTP (19.0-19.4 kWh net). Base price i5 eDrive40 EUR 70,900.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0016.value: 205 kW DC peak, 10-80 % in 30 min, 157-211 km WLTP added in 10 min (eDrive40); AC 11 kW standard / 22 kW optional (4U6, EUR 1,200; standard on i5 M60)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0016.notes: System voltage (400 V vs 800 V) not stated in the price list. PHEVs: AC 11 kW only, no DC charging figure printed.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0017.value: Wheelbase 2,995 mm, length 5,060 mm; rear headroom 969 mm; rear legroom not stated
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0017.notes: Dimension labels are inferred from an unlabeled drawing (extraction note 16); wheelbase/length high confidence, headroom less certain. Rear interior width 1,497 mm (inferred label).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0018.notes: PHEVs keep the 520 l of the combustion models per the technical data. 40:20:40 through-loading standard.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0019.trim_scope: i5 eDrive40, i5 xDrive40, i5 M60 xDrive (BEV)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0019.notes: BEV boot 30 l smaller than ICE/PHEV (520 l).

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0020.value: harman/kardon HiFi speaker system standard; Bowers & Wilkins Surround Sound System optional (6F4, EUR 750)
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0020.notes: Speaker count/wattage not stated in the price list. BMW IconicSounds Electric standard on BEV/PHEV.

luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0021.value: Panorama Glasdach 402 incl. black high-gloss roof paint, EUR 1,630
luis:bmw_baseline_outlook-E0021.notes: Optional on all 10 models, standard on none. Alcantara headliner 776 only in combination with the glass roof.
